text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Once again... Happy birthday, Urara. I 
hope you enjoyed my present.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! A whole bunch of carrot breads! They 
were super yummy!! But—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Something magical happened~! I thought, 
'I'm gonna eat a ton just like Oguri-san!' 
and chow-chow-chowed down, but then...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Before I knew it, everyone had gathered 
around me! I wonder why~?!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, everyone was cheering for you, 
Urara. Watching you eat with all your 
might.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
If I had been there, I'm sure I would have 
cheered for you too.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ehh! Is that so~! It makes my heart feel 
all warm and fuzzy! Ehehe~♪

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Urara just realized, but Oguri-san, 
it's because you're so excited, right!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone gathers around you all the time 
too, right, Oguri-san? Like during 
mealtime, or at the races!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Oguri-san like that makes me so 
excited! It's amazing! I can't help 
wondering what you'll do next~!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I want to eat tons and run like crazy just 
like Oguri-san! And get everyone super 
excited~!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yeah, you can do it. Definitely.
